text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents a non-review research study that explicitly focuses on national-scale (China) future land use and land cover change (LUCC) simulation. It implements two SSP-RCP future scenarios (SSP1-RCP2.6 and SSP5-RCP8.5), uses spatially explicit modeling at 1 km resolution, includes quantitative accuracy validation via Figure of Merit (FoM) metrics against historical data (2001–2010 and 2001–2015), and produces mapped LULC projections to 2100. The primary objective is to improve LUCC prediction by coupling a mechanistic vegetation model (LPJ) with a cellular automata model (FLUS) at the cell level, satisfying all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.)
